en: Black‑and‑white image showing a long line of young women standing closely together, apparently dancing or processing on an elevated ridge or platform. They wear traditional folk costumes with pleated white skirts, embroidered aprons and blouses, dark sleeveless vests, and headscarves or floral headbands. Above them stretches a diagonal string of small hanging light bulbs, suggesting an outdoor festival or celebration at dusk. No visible text or caption appears on the front.
